conversations_memory:
Researchers keep a lab notebook so that a later reader can replay the conditions of an experiment.

A claim without an observation that could refute it is not yet a hypothesis.

project_memories.thermo-notes:
Closed systems always increase entropy when heat flows in and no work leaves.

Open systems can export entropy and so decrease it locally.

memory_files.content:
- [stated] Heat always increases entropy in an isolated system.
- [stated] A feedback controller can decrease variance around a set point.
- [stated] Selection pressure can shrink diversity inside a local niche.
